thread:
Maria - Sales Eng: Hey team, heads-up — FinGuard POC goes live tomorrow. They asked for a short capacity burst (approx 4x baseline) during onboarding for ~2 hours. Can we provision a temporary reserve and tweak autoscale so it doesn't immediately scale in?
Sam - AE: Customer is ok with a one-off invoice. Need a quick pricing estimate for a 2h/4x burst and confirmation we can do it in Dedicated.
Jordan - Solutions Eng: @Nadia we can either (A) extend scaling_window and prewarm extra nodes, or (B) provision a short-term reservation for the window. Option B keeps SLOs tight. What do you need from sales to trigger provisioning?
Nadia - Platform Eng: For a short reserve we need: pool name, desired total GPUs, start/end times, and billing approval. Also, for Dedicated in a Private/VPC setup we need an infra ticket for network/route validation.
Maria - Sales Eng: Baseline for this pool is 2x A100 (2 GPUs). 4x baseline means 8 GPUs total, so +6 GPUs. Target start: 2026-03-21 12:00 UTC, duration ~3 hours to be safe. Billing approval coming today.
Alex - SRE: Two operational notes: (1) bump min_instances for the window so autoscaler doesn't scale in, (2) add a scaling_window_seconds of ~300s to avoid flapping after the spike. We'll also run a short canary (25% traffic -> 100%).
Sam - AE: Pricing ask: can you send a line-item estimate I can paste in the PO?
Nadia - Platform Eng: Quick back-of-envelope: 6 extra A100-equivalent GPUs * $12/hr * 3 hours = ~$216. I'll compute exact with instance mix and send final. Also need the burst_credit top-up if they will burst beyond sustained rate.
Jordan - Solutions Eng: Suggested autoscale snippet we can apply (example):
```
autoscale:
  min_instances: 4
  max_instances: 8
  scaling_window_seconds: 300
  burst_policy: temporary_reserve
  reserve_until: 2026-03-21T15:00:00Z
```
Maria - Sales Eng: They are in Private (VPC) mode — does that change anything operationally?
Nadia - Platform Eng: In Private, we can't change host networking without an infra ticket. I need INF ticket for reserve + security sign-off for temporary routing. KMS is already enabled for them so keys are fine.
Maria - Sales Eng: Got it. I'll attach the budget approval when ready.
Alex - SRE: Also recommend prewarming KV cache for common prompts to avoid cold-token latency during onboarding. That's an internal runbook step, low risk.
Maria - Sales Eng: Noted.
Jordan - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare a short runbook and rollback playbook.
Maria - Sales Eng: @deploy-bot can you open the infra ticket for temporary capacity reserve (FinGuard POC)?
deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-5721: "temp-reserve FinGuard POC - 6 GPUs from 2026-03-21T12:00Z to 2026-03-21T15:00Z". Assigned to Nadia - Platform Eng.
Nadia - Platform Eng: I'll pick this up. Once INF-5721 is approved I'll provision the reserve, update the autoscale policy, and attach audit logs with 90-day retention.
Sam - AE: Any security questionnaire items still outstanding? They asked about data isolation and audit logs.
Maria - Sales Eng: Sent our security pack earlier; they want explicit KMS confirmation and audit retention. I confirmed KMS on the account.
Nadia - Platform Eng: KMS confirmed. We'll attach session-level logs and an audit export. No extra infra changes required for that.
Alex - SRE: Plan for execution: provision reserve -> prewarm nodes -> deploy canary at 25% for 10m -> ramp to 100% -> monitor latency/cost -> release reserve at end time.
Jordan - Solutions Eng: I'll drop the runbook in the ticket.
Maria - Sales Eng: Target start remains 2026-03-21 12:00 UTC. I'll post budget approval in this thread when I have it.
Sam - AE: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — i’ll update the customer with the estimate and next steps.
Maria - Sales Eng: Will confirm once INF-5721 is approved and Nadia confirms provisioning done.
